_note: Public TOON devnet on Linode. Committed SAMPLE (placeholder DOMAIN). On the live host, devnet.sh regenerates this from .env. Peers point a TOON node/SDK at these URLs (chainRpcUrls / EVM_RPC_URL).

solana._fund: infra/solana/fund-solana.sh <pubkey> — airdrops SOL + transfers mock USDC from the treasury

mina._fund: infra/mina/fund-mina-usdc.sh <b58> [usdc] — admin-mints USDC on the public devnet (admin authority = MINA_USDC_ADMIN_KEY)
mina._connectorNote: On the live box the connector reads via the minascan upstream directly (the mina.<DOMAIN> proxy 504s on send). Set chainProviders[mina].graphqlUrl to the upstream, tokenAddress/tokenId to these live values. The connector verify path follows the per-claim channelAccount, so client-opened channels work; demoChannelZkApp is a pre-OPEN USDC channel for quick checks.
mina._note: Passthrough proxy of the PUBLIC Mina devnet (no node). USDC FungibleToken (UsdcChannelToken, 6dp) deployed ONCE to public devnet (deploy tx 5JuCoRk6xvJDZ82Hz2VFGzqUYsu24Y1rusEQzkKFxS8CNZF48Wdn); survives box rebuilds. Deploy keys (deployer/admin/token) are NOT committed — held by the operator. Faucet should admin-mint USDC (via tools/mina/fund-usdc.ts using MINA_USDC_ADMIN_KEY) alongside its native-MINA drip.

_decimalsNote: USDC is 6-decimal on every chain (EVM + Solana), so claim base units are uniform — no cross-chain normalization needed.
